statement: After the fall of Acre (1291), the Knights Hospitaller retreated to Cyprus, which they used as a base for another 20 years before conquering Rhodes (1309). Cyprus provided the order's headquarters, naval facilities, and recruitment grounds during the critical transition from a land-based military order to a maritime one. The order's presence in Cyprus also entangled it in the complex dynastic politics of the Lusignan kingdom — a relationship that both aided and complicated the order's development of its new Mediterranean naval role.
